title: A Study for Exploring the Efficacy of Naoxintong Capsules in the Treatment of Coronary Atherosclerotic Plaque on the Basis of Optimal Medical Therapy (Aspirin,Statins,Clopidogrel, Etc.): Stage One

sections.abstract: To evaluate and compare the change of plaque composition by VH-IVUS imaging in subjects who take NXT and placebo in post-PCI of AMI patients during 12 months follow-up.
